description: Visits to your RankControl articles over time, from RankControl's own page analytics: pageViews and visitors for each period, oldest first. One row a day for 7 or 30 days and one row a week, starting Monday, for 90 (default 30). Null, with a hint, until the Analytics screen is turned on (activate_analytics_screen). For the whole site from Google Analytics, use get_traffic_overview with scope "site".
name: get_traffic_trend
